newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to push up to around 4,930.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to push up to around 4,930.

text.p: Investor appetite for UK shares will continue unabated on Wednesday and this should push the FTSE 100 index up to around 4,930, technical analysts said.

The foray into record territory on Tuesday indicates the market's upward trend is not over and with help from banking shares and pharmaceuticals today this will make a sixth day of consecutive rises for the FTSE, they added.
Market breadth for the FTSE should at least match Tuesday's two-to-one ratio of advancing stocks to those declining as market bulls show their assertiveness once more.
By 0740 GMT, the FTSE was up 21.6 at 4,920.9.
